# earliest start

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/earliestStart>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The earliest instant at which an event could have started — the lower bound of a fuzzy / approximate date ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)). Pairs with [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) and a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value to model uncertainty without abandoning DL-clean base triples.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the lower bound of a fuzzy or approximate date — 'sometime in the 1850s', 'circa 1200' — paired with [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) and a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a crisply known instant (use [`gmeow:eventTime`](gmeow-eventTime.md)) or span (use [`gmeow:eventInterval`](gmeow-eventInterval.md)), and avoid asserting only one bound — the lower and upper bounds bracket the fuzzy date together.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) and [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) bounds plus a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value; the solver layer (P12) does any fuzzy-interval arithmetic.

### Examples

- ex:battle [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) "1850-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) "1859-12-31T23:59:59Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) [`gmeow:precisionDecade`](../individuals/gmeow-precisionDecade.md).
